sources.scope: Nominal entrance scale and morphology only; no point cloud was ingested.

parameter_provenance.opening_radii_m: Nominal half dimensions from the reported 55 by 49 m reference; irregular outline is authored.
parameter_provenance.nominal_depth_m: Reference scale; exact deepest point varies with the authored funnel and floor.
parameter_provenance.center_and_z_datum: Arbitrary local coordinates chosen to connect a synthetic underground segment near x=0.
parameter_provenance.funnel_and_walls: Observed morphology motivates a shallow funnel and locally overhung walls; positions and amplitudes are not fitted observations.
parameter_provenance.talus_and_relief: Deterministic authored geometric roughness and mounds, not measured individual rocks.
parameter_provenance.wall_roughness_model: Aperiodic hash-grid fracture geometry and sparse local ledge patches; no periodic all-around bed rings. Legacy configs without this flag replay the previous field.
parameter_provenance.connectivity: The connection to the Zhou-inspired cave is a generation assumption, not one measured lunar site.
